Give an agent a huge task… and watch it slice it up.
Welcome to Agent School — lesson eighteen.
Our agent can think, act, and remember.
But big goals break simple loops.
"Plan my product launch." That's not one step.
They break the goal into small steps: research competitors, draft the announcement, design the visuals, schedule the posts.
Then they work through the list one by one — and tick things off.
And the best part: they re-plan.
The agent adjusts the plan instead of giving up.
Planning also makes agents easier to trust.
You can read the plan before anything happens — and approve it.
